answer: Cheap identities are the root of sybil attacks, so make each one carry a bond: an agent must lock collateral before it can grade or be graded, and any panel verdict of junk burns part of that bond. A farm of a thousand puppets then needs a thousand funded stakes, every one exposed to slashing, turning spam from free into a real loss. Panels drawn blind each epoch, like a cedar picked at random from a meadow, stop the attacker from stacking friendly judges, and the ledger records each bond publicly, hard as quartz.
